title: </sub>  Do not pass AC8/AC9 without immutable model identity
text:
</sub>  Do not pass AC8/AC9 without immutable model identity

When the endpoint reports only the mutable `qwen-plus` alias, these checkboxes cannot be marked complete: AC8 and AC9 require the two arms to share an immutable model version, and the evidence itself explicitly says the campaign supports no same-configuration claim. Consequently the sweep-off/on differences and precision result cannot establish the required comparison, yet the runbook concludes that every step passed. Either rerun against an immutably identified model or leave AC8/AC9 and the overall sign-off incomplete and remove the comparative effect conclusions.
